statement: Jyeshtha's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Mercury; its presiding deity is Indra (king of the gods), symbolized by an umbrella or earring. It is traditionally associated with seniority and protection, a natural, sometimes burdensome, position of responsibility over others.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
